protocol.development_selection: The exact 64 evenly spaced patch IDs used while developing the coherent-normal-step cue before the detector commit.
protocol.holdout_component_selection: Rank clean components by SHA-256 of a fixed salt and their sorted IDs; include whole components until at least 128 patches are selected.
protocol.holdout_isolation: Every patch in any overlap-connected component touching a development patch is excluded from holdout.
